hooks.command: CMD=$(python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   if [ -f mlb_hr_engine_v4/graphify-out/graph.json ]; then     FRESH=$(python .claude/graphify_freshness.py 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN);     if [ "$FRESH" = "STALE" ]; then       echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify graph is STALE (older than recent code changes) — regenerate with `graphify update mlb_hr_engine_v4` or inspect current files directly. Do not rely on graph output. Do not propagate graphify guidance to subagents."}}';     else       echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"RECOMMENDED: graphify graph is fresh. Use `graphify query \"<question>\"` first for orientation on non-trivial grep searches. For trivial targeted searches, grepping directly is fine."}}';     fi;   fi ;; esac

HIT=$(python -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);t=d.get('tool_input',d);s=(str(t.get('file_path') or '')+' '+str(t.get('pattern') or '')+' '+str(t.get('path') or '')).lower().replace(chr(92),'/');exts=('.py','.js','.ts','.tsx','.jsx','.go','.rs','.java','.rb','.c','.h','.cpp','.hpp','.cc','.cs','.kt','.swift','.php','.scala','.lua','.sh','.md','.rst','.txt','.mdx');sys.stdout.write('1' if 'graphify-out/' not in s and any(e in s for e in exts) else '')" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$HIT" = 1 ] && [ -f mlb_hr_engine_v4/graphify-out/graph.json ]; then   FRESH=$(python .claude/graphify_freshness.py 2>/dev/null || echo UNKNOWN);   if [ "$FRESH" = "STALE" ]; then     echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify graph is STALE (older than recent code changes) — regenerate with `graphify update mlb_hr_engine_v4` or inspect current files directly. Do not rely on graph output. Do not propagate graphify guidance to subagents."}}';   else     echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"RECOMMENDED: graphify graph is fresh. Use `graphify query \"<question>\"` first for orientation on non-trivial source investigation. For trivial single-file lookups, reading directly is fine."}}';   fi; fi || true
